post.description:
Receipts are used to record money received against a bank account (Sage 200 Standard and versions of Professional released after July 2017). In the Sage 200 app, this is equivalent to making a Nominal Vatable Receipt or a Non-Vatable Receipt.

Posting a bank receipt does not actually create a 'bank receipt' entity, but a Posted Transaction of type 'BankAccountEntryType.Receipt', therefore it is not possible to 'get' a bank receipt using the same API endpoint after it has been posted. Posting a bank receipt returns a URN (Unique Reference Number) that can be used to find the corresponding posted transaction.

Note: Before posting bank receipts via the API, at least one bank account must exist within Sage 200.

200.description: The bank receipt was created. Response body will include the urn of the transactions created.

400.description: There was a problem with the request. Request body will include details.

Posting a bank payment returns a URN (Unique Reference Number) that can be used to find the corresponding posted transaction.

Note: Before posting a bank payment via the API, at least one bank account must exist within Sage 200.

200.description: The bank payment was created. Response body will include the urn of the transactions created.

bank_receipt.description:
Receipts are used to record money received against a bank account (Sage 200 Standard and versions of Professional released after July 2017). In the Sage 200 app, this is equivalent to making a Nominal Vatable Receipt or a Non-Vatable Receipt.

Posting a bank receipt does not actually create a 'bank receipt' entity, but a Posted Transaction of type 'BankAccountEntryType.Receipt', therefore it is not possible to 'get' a bank receipt using the same API endpoint after it has been posted. Posting a bank receipt returns a URN (Unique Reference Number) that can be used to find the corresponding posted transaction.

Note: Before posting bank receipts via the API, at least one bank account must exist within Sage 200.

bank_id.description:
Bank record Id that the receipt is for. If the bank account does not have the same currency as the base currency, then additional properties can be set for the currency and exchange rate.

Note: If a default bank account has been set up in the system, then you do not need to specify the bank account Id, if that is the intended bank for the receipt.

transaction_date.description: Transaction date. This defaults to the current system date.

reference.description: Receipt reference (can be the cheque number).

tax_registration_number.description: The tax registration number of the person the money has been received from (Sage 200 Education Online only).

narrative.description: The description that is set to default on each nominal analysis item.

exchange_rate.description: The exchange rate between the bank account and the system. This is only applicable if the bank account currency specified is different to the base currency and will default to the bank currency exchange rate.

cheque_currency_id.description: The currency Id of the receipt. This is only applicable if the bank account currency specified is different to the base currency and will default to the bank account currency.

cheque_exchange_rate.description: The exchange rate between the cheque and the bank account. This is only applicable if the bank account currency specified is different to the base currency and will default to the cheque currency exchange rate.

tax_code_id.description: Tax code record Id. This is only applicable if the bank account currency specified is different to the base currency and will default to the default tax code Id.

cheque_value.description: Value of the receipt. This is only applicable if the bank account currency specified is different to the base currency.

cheque_goods_value.description: The net value of the receipt. This is only applicable if the bank account currency specified is different to the base currency.

cheque_tax_value.description: The tax element of the receipt. This is only applicable if the bank account currency specified is different to the base currency.

nominal_analysis_items.description: The nominal analysis lines that relate to the receipt, such as the account code, values and date.

cost_centre.description: Cost centre. If specified must correspond to the code.

department.description: Department. If specified must correspond to the code.

gross_value.description: Gross receipt value to post to the nominal account.

goods_value.description: Net value to post to the nominal account. This is not applicable if the bank account currency specified is different to the base currency.

tax_code_id.description: Tax code Id. This is not applicable if the bank account currency specified is different to the base currency and will default to the default tax code Id

tax_value.description: Tax value to post to the nominal account. This is not applicable if the bank account currency specified is different to the base currency.

transaction_date.description: Transaction date. This defaults to the current system date.

bank_charges.description: The nominal analysis items which relate to bank charges for the receipt. This is only applicable if the bank account currency specified is different to the base currency.

bank_transfer.description:
Bank transfers are used to transfer money from one bank to another. In the Sage 200 app, this is equivalent to making an Inter Account Transfer.

Note: before posting a bank transfer via the API both the bank you are transferring from, and the bank you are transferring to, must exist within Sage 200.

bank_from_id.description: The unique Id of the bank the payment will transfer from.

bank_to_id.description: The unique Id of the bank the payment will transfer to.

narrative.description: The narrative for the bank transfer.

reference.description: The reference for the bank transfer.

second_reference.description: A second reference for the bank transfer.

transaction_date.description: The date of the bank transfer.

receipt_value.description: The receipt value of the bank transfer. This is only applicable if either of the bank accounts currency specified is different to the base currency.

exchange_rate.description: The exchange rate used for the bank transfer. This is only applicable if either of the bank accounts currency specified is different to the base currency.

commission_value.description: The amount of commission associated with the bank transfer. This is only applicable if either of the bank accounts currency specified is different to the base currency.

commission_code.description: The commission nominal code for the bank transfer. This is only applicable if either of the bank accounts currency specified is different to the base currency.

commission_cost_centre.description: The commission cost centre for the bank transfer. This is only applicable if either of the bank accounts currency specified is different to the base currency.

commission_department.description: The commission department for the bank transfer. This is only applicable if either of the bank accounts currency specified is different to the base currency.

commission_payer.description: Who will pay the commission on the bank transfer. The accepted values are PaymentBank or ReceiptBank. This is only applicable if either of the bank accounts currency specified is different to the base currency.

payment_to_base_exchange_rate.description: The exchange rate to convert from the payment_value currency to the base currency. This is only applicable if the bank account from currency specified is different to the base currency.

receipt_to_base_exchange_rate.description: The exchange rate to convert from the receipt_value currency to the base currency. This is only applicable if the bank account to currency specified is different to the base currency.

exchange_difference_code.description: The exchange difference nominal code for the bank transfer. This is only applicable if either of payment_to_base_exchange_rate or receipt_to_base_exchange_rate are changed.

exchange_difference_cost_centre.description: The exchange difference cost centre for the bank transfer. This is only applicable if either of payment_to_base_exchange_rate or receipt_to_base_exchange_rate are changed.

exchange_difference_department.description: The exchange difference department for the bank transfer. This is only applicable if either of payment_to_base_exchange_rate or receipt_to_base_exchange_rate are changed.

urn.description: This is the description of the urn.

statement_page_number.description: The page number of the bank statement to which the transaction was reconciled.
